    <style>
        :root {
            --bg-color: #0b0908;
            --dd-dark: #120e0d;
            --dd-panel: #1a1513;
            --dd-border: #3b2a20;
            --dd-gold: #c69b3f;
            --dd-gold-bright: #e7be60;
            --dd-gold-dark: #7a5c1e;
            --dd-red: #8f1c1c;
            --wood-base: #2c1a11;
            --wood-dark: #1b0f0a;
            --wood-highlight: #462c1e;
            --font-title: 'Cinzel', 'Georgia', serif;
            --font-body: 'Crimson Text', 'Palatino', serif;
        }

        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            user-select: none;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }

        body {
            background-color: var(--bg-color);
            color: #d8cbb8;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            overflow-x: hidden;
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            background-image: 
                radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(143, 28, 28, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 2px);
            background-size: 100% 100%, 100% 100%, 100% 3px;
        }

        /* ====================================================
           顶部状态栏与胶囊导航 (仅保留: 购物记录、LLM设置、全屏)
        ==================================================== */
        header {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #181210 0%, #0d0a09 100%);
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--dd-border);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.85);
            padding: 10px 24px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            z-index: 50;
            position: relative;
        }

        header::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -2px;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, var(--dd-gold) 50%, transparent 100%);
        }

        .shop-title-box {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .shop-emblem {
            font-size: 26px;
            color: var(--dd-gold);
            text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.5);
            animation: flameFlicker 3s infinite ease-in-out;
        }

        .shop-title-text h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: 2.5px;
            color: var(--dd-gold-bright);
            text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px #000, 0 0 12px rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.3);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .shop-title-text p {
            font-size: 12px;
            letter-spacing: 1.5px;
            color: #8c7866;
            margin-top: 1px;
        }

        .header-controls {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .status-indicators {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .status-pill {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            background: #140f0d;
            border: 1px solid var(--dd-border);
            padding: 5px 12px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
        }

        .status-pill .label {
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #a48e78;
        }

        .status-pill .value {
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #d6af66;
            text-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.9), 0 0 10px rgba(214, 175, 102, 0.25);
        }



        /* 顶部胶囊操作栏 (参考图1风格) */
        .top-pill-group {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .top-pill-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #221813 0%, #140d0a 100%);
            border: 1px solid #4a3424;
            color: #d1c0aa;
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            padding: 6px 16px;
            border-radius: 9999px;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            transition: all 0.22s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .top-pill-btn:hover {
            border-color: var(--dd-gold);
            color: #f7ebd7;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
        }

        .top-pill-btn.active {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3d2315 0%, #201109 100%);
            border-color: var(--dd-gold);
            color: #f7e7c8;
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.35);
        }

        /* ====================================================
           主体陈列布局 (展台 + 方案2工匠实木托盘柜)
        ==================================================== */
        main {
            flex: 1;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 430px 1fr;
            gap: 20px;
            padding: 14px 24px;
            max-width: 1700px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            width: 100%;
        }

        /* 左侧：铁匠立绘展台 */
        .blacksmith-stage {
            position: relative;
            background: #140e0c;
            border: 2px solid var(--dd-border);
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.9), 0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
            border-radius: 6px;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            min-height: 520px;
        }

        .stage-bg {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-size: cover;
            background-position: center top;
            opacity: 0.35;
            filter: contrast(110%) brightness(85%);
            transition: opacity 0.5s ease;
        }

        .ambient-light {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15) 0%, transparent 60%),
                        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 80%, rgba(0,0,0,0.8) 0%, transparent 80%);
            pointer-events: none;
            mix-blend-mode: screen;
            animation: torchFlicker 4s infinite ease-in-out;
        }

        .portrait-wrapper {
            position: relative;
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            justify-content: center;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding-bottom: 0;
        }

        .blacksmith-img {
            max-height: 380px;
            width: auto;
            object-fit: contain;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 15px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.9));
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            transform: translateY(20px);
        }

        .blacksmith-img:hover {
            transform: translateY(16px) scale(1.02);
            filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 30px rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.2));
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        /* 气泡式台词弹窗 (商品介绍与老板反馈) */
        .boss-speech-bubble {
            position: absolute;
            top: 14px;
            right: 16px;
            left: 16px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #241712 0%, #150d09 100%);
            border: 2px solid var(--dd-gold);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.95), 0 0 15px rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.25);
            z-index: 20;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(-8px) scale(0.95);
            transition: all 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.18, 0.89, 0.32, 1.28);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .boss-speech-bubble.show {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
            pointer-events: auto;
        }

        .boss-speech-bubble::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -10px;
            left: 60px;
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
            border-left: 9px solid transparent;
            border-right: 9px solid transparent;
            border-top: 10px solid var(--dd-gold);
        }

        .bubble-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #3d291c;
            padding-bottom: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .bubble-title {
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--dd-gold-bright);
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .bubble-item-badge {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: #cbbaa5;
            background: #120b08;
            padding: 1px 6px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            border: 1px solid #3d291c;
        }

        .bubble-close {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: #7a5e4d;
            font-size: 16px;
            cursor: pointer;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .bubble-close:hover {
            color: var(--dd-gold);
        }

        .bubble-text {
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.45;
            color: #f2e4d0;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        /* 右侧：方案2 简约无边框 · 工匠实木托盘 (Artisan Floating Trays) */
        .cabinet-section {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .cabinet-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1c130e 0%, #120b08 100%);
            border: 1px solid var(--dd-border);
            padding: 5px 12px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            min-height: 42px;
        }

        /* 商品分类 Tab 标签组 */
        .category-tabs {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .cat-tab {
            background: #18100c;
            border: 1px solid #362318;
            color: #9c836e;
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            padding: 5px 12px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }

        .cat-tab:hover {
            background: #251610;
            border-color: #63422c;
            color: #dfb06c;
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .cat-tab.active {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3d2517 0%, #1e110a 100%);
            border: 1px solid var(--dd-gold);
            color: var(--dd-gold-bright);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 10px rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.25);
        }

        .cat-badge {
            font-size: 10px;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            padding: 0 5px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            color: #8c7360;
        }

        .cat-tab.active .cat-badge {
            background: rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.2);
            border-color: rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.4);
            color: var(--dd-gold-bright);
        }

        .cabinet-tip {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: #7a6352;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            padding-right: 4px;
        }

        .wooden-cabinet {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
            grid-auto-rows: 114px;
            gap: 10px;
            background: transparent;
            padding: 6px 2px 2px 2px;
            border: none;
            box-shadow: none;
            position: relative;
            /* 柜内独立滚动：可视区固定约 4 行高度，超量只在柜内纵滚 */
            max-height: 496px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            scrollbar-gutter: stable;
            scrollbar-width: thin;
            scrollbar-color: #63422c #120b08;
        }

        /* 货柜暗金细滚动条（仅作用于货柜） */
        #woodenCabinet::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
        }
        #woodenCabinet::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #120b08;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        #woodenCabinet::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #63422c;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        #woodenCabinet::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: var(--dd-gold);
        }

        .shelf-cell {
            height: 114px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 6px 6px 8px 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2b1d15 0%, #1a100a 100%);
            box-shadow: 
                0 5px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.85), 
                inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.09), 
                inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
            transition: all 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }

        .shelf-cell:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #38251b 0%, #22140d 100%);
            box-shadow: 
                0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.95), 
                inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.15),
                0 0 15px rgba(223, 176, 108, 0.25);
            z-index: 5;
        }

        .shelf-cell.in-cart {
            outline: 1px solid rgba(223, 176, 108, 0.6);
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(223, 176, 108, 0.35);
        }

        /* 空置托盘样式 (保证 4x5 柜体几何恒定) */
        .shelf-cell.shelf-cell-empty {
            opacity: 0.35;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1d130e 0%, #120a06 100%);
            box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.85);
            border: 1px dashed rgba(196, 157, 99, 0.15);
            cursor: default;
        }
        .shelf-cell.shelf-cell-empty:hover {
            transform: none;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1d130e 0%, #120a06 100%);
            box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.85);
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* 稀有度暗色隐式底部光条 */
        .shelf-cell::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 20%;
            right: 20%;
            height: 1px;
            opacity: 0.35;
            transition: opacity 0.2s, height 0.2s;
        }
        .shelf-cell:hover::after {
            opacity: 0.85;
            height: 2px;
        }
        .shelf-cell[data-tier="military"]::after { background: #3b82f6; }
        .shelf-cell[data-tier="illegal"]::after { background: #f97316; }
        .shelf-cell[data-tier="detective"]::after { background: #eab308; }
        .shelf-cell[data-tier="occult"]::after { background: #ef4444; }

        .shelf-num {
            position: absolute;
            top: 4px;
            left: 6px;
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 10px;
            color: #9f836d;
            opacity: 0.55;
            transition: opacity 0.2s;
        }
        .shelf-cell:hover .shelf-num {
            opacity: 0.9;
        }

        /* 数量标识徽章 (针对多数量商品) */
        .shelf-stock-badge {
            position: absolute;
            top: 4px;
            right: 6px;
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 9px;
            color: #c49d63;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            border: 1px solid rgba(196, 157, 99, 0.4);
            padding: 1px 4px;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .item-icon-box {
            font-size: 36px;
            line-height: 1;
            margin-top: 4px;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.85));
            transition: transform 0.2s ease;
        }

        .shelf-cell:hover .item-icon-box {
            transform: scale(1.12) translateY(-2px);
        }

        .item-meta {
            width: 100%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
            gap: 1px;
        }

        .item-name {
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #cbbaa5;
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
            max-width: 95%;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            display: block;
            text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
        }

        .item-price {
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #dfb06c;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
        }

        .sold-stamp {
            position: absolute;
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: #a82424;
            border: 2px dashed #a82424;
            padding: 1px 8px;
            transform: rotate(-18deg);
            background: rgba(168, 36, 36, 0.12);
            text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
            pointer-events: none;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            animation: stampIn 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.18, 0.89, 0.32, 1.28);
        }

        /* ====================================================
           底栏控制台 (至多四个我方头像 + 缩略购物车 + 输入栏)
        ==================================================== */
        .bottom-console {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #160f0c 0%, #0d0907 100%);
            border-top: 2px solid var(--dd-border);
            box-shadow: 0 -6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
            padding: 12px 24px 14px 24px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
            max-width: 1700px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            width: 100%;
            z-index: 40;
        }

        .console-upper-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
            gap: 20px;
            align-items: stretch;
        }

        /* 至多四个我方角色的头像 (无需属性栏) */
        .party-deck {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .party-card {
            width: 90px;
            height: 96px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #221611 0%, #120b08 100%);
            border: 2px solid #3d291c;
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            transition: all 0.22s ease;
        }

        .party-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            border-color: var(--dd-gold);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.3);
        }

        .party-card.active {
            border-color: var(--dd-gold-bright);
            box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.5), inset 0 0 8px rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.2);
        }

        .party-card.active::before {
            content: '说话中';
            position: absolute;
            top: 2px;
            right: 2px;
            font-size: 8px;
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            background: rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.85);
            color: #120b08;
            font-weight: bold;
            padding: 1px 4px;
            border-radius: 2px;
            z-index: 5;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .party-avatar-img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            object-fit: cover;
            object-position: center top;
            filter: contrast(105%) brightness(95%);
            transition: transform 0.2s;
        }

        .party-card:hover .party-avatar-img {
            transform: scale(1.06);
        }

        /* 购物车区域：缩略仅显示图标与数量 + 展开按钮 */
        .cart-panel {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1b120e 0%, #110b08 100%);
            border: 1px solid #3a261a;
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: 8px 14px;
            height: 96px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
            box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
        }

        .cart-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #2d1c12;
            padding-bottom: 3px;
        }

        .cart-title {
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--dd-gold);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .cart-badge {
            background: #2e1710;
            border: 1px solid #6b3520;
            color: #e5987a;
            font-size: 10px;
            padding: 1px 6px;
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        /* 缩略图标列表：仅显示图标和数量 (如 🔫×1, 🪙×50) */
        .cart-mini-scroller {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            overflow-x: auto;
            padding: 4px 0;
            align-items: center;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .cart-mini-chip {
            background: #140d09;
            border: 1px solid #442a1b;
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: 3px 8px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            animation: slideIn 0.2s ease;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .cart-mini-chip:hover {
            border-color: var(--dd-gold);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .cart-mini-chip .mini-emoji {
            font-size: 18px;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .cart-mini-chip .mini-qty {
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #dfb06c;
        }

        .cart-empty-text {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #634f40;
            font-style: italic;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        .cart-footer {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            border-top: 1px solid #2d1c12;
            padding-top: 3px;
        }

        .cart-total-box {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-family: var(--font-title);
        }

        .cart-total-label {
            color: #8c7360;
        }

        .cart-total-amount {
            color: #dfb06c;
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .cart-btn-group {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .cart-expand-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2a1d16 0%, #150d09 100%);
            border: 1px solid #8c6a43;
            color: #cbbaa5;
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 5px;
        }

        .cart-expand-btn:hover {
            border-color: var(--dd-gold);
            color: #f7e7c8;
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .cart-checkout-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #442a1a 0%, #20130b 100%);
            border: 1px solid #c49d63;
            color: #f7e7c8;
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            padding: 4px 14px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .cart-checkout-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #573620 0%, #2d1a0e 100%);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(196, 157, 99, 0.4);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .cart-checkout-btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.4;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            border-color: #4a3424;
        }

        /* 最下方：胶囊输入栏 */
        .chat-input-bar {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            background: #0f0a08;
            border: 1px solid #3d291c;
            border-radius: 9999px;
            padding: 5px 14px;
            box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
            transition: border-color 0.2s;
        }

        .chat-input-bar:focus-within {
            border-color: var(--dd-gold);
            box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.9), 0 0 10px rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.2);
        }

        .current-hero-avatar {
            width: 30px;
            height: 30px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 1px solid var(--dd-gold);
            object-fit: cover;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
        }

        .chat-text-input {
            flex: 1;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            outline: none;
            color: #e5d7c3;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: 14px;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .chat-text-input::placeholder {
            color: #6d5747;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        .input-action-btn {
            background: #1c130e;
            border: 1px solid #4a3322;
            color: #a48e78;
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 11px;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 9999px;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 5px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .input-action-btn:hover {
            border-color: var(--dd-gold);
            color: #f7e7c8;
        }

        .input-action-btn.active {
            background: #143521;
            border-color: #22c55e;
            color: #86efac;
        }

        .send-submit-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #442a1a 0%, #20130b 100%);
            border: 1px solid var(--dd-gold);
            color: #f7e7c8;
            width: 30px;
            height: 30px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 13px;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
        }

        .send-submit-btn:hover {
            transform: scale(1.08);
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.4);
            border-color: var(--dd-gold-bright);
        }

        /* ====================================================
           弹窗系统 (数量拉条弹窗、购物车详情面板、账本、LLM设置)
        ==================================================== */
        .inspect-modal-backdrop {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78);
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
            z-index: 100;
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
        }

        .inspect-modal-backdrop.show {
            display: flex;
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .parchment-card {
            background: #17110e;
            background-image: 
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.05) 0%, transparent 80%),
                linear-gradient(180deg, #221814 0%, #140d0a 100%);
            border: 2px solid var(--dd-gold);
            box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.95), 0 0 20px rgba(198, 155, 63, 0.25);
            border-radius: 4px;
            width: 500px;
            max-width: 92vw;
            max-height: 86vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 22px;
            position: relative;
            transform: scale(0.95);
            transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.18, 0.89, 0.32, 1.28);
        }

        .inspect-modal-backdrop.show .parchment-card {
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        .modal-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-start;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dd-gold-dark);
            padding-bottom: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 14px;
        }

        .modal-title-group {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .modal-item-name {
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--dd-gold-bright);
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .modal-item-tier {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #a48c77;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .modal-close-btn {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: #735b49;
            font-size: 22px;
            cursor: pointer;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .modal-close-btn:hover {
            color: var(--dd-gold);
        }

        .history-filters {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 6px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .history-filter-btn {
            background: #160f0c;
            border: 1px solid #4a3322;
            color: #a48e78;
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        .history-filter-btn.active {
            color: #160f0c;
            background: var(--dd-gold);
            border-color: var(--dd-gold-bright);
        }

        .shop-event-log {
            max-height: 280px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 6px;
            padding-right: 4px;
        }

        .shop-event-row {
            background: rgba(12, 8, 6, 0.72);
            border: 1px solid #352319;
            border-left: 3px solid #6e5036;
            padding: 7px 9px;
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.45;
            color: #cfbfab;
        }

        .shop-event-row[data-kind="dialog"] { border-left-color: #8f755c; }
        .shop-event-row[data-kind="cart"] { border-left-color: #6f8e9f; }
        .shop-event-row[data-kind="add"] { border-left-color: #799a64; }
        .shop-event-row[data-kind="error"] { border-left-color: #b84e49; color: #e7a19d; }
        .shop-event-time { color: #725f50; margin-right: 6px; }
        .shop-event-empty { color: #6d5747; padding: 18px; text-align: center; }

        .avatar-chat-bubble {
            position: fixed;
            z-index: 220;
            width: min(220px, calc(100vw - 16px));
            padding: 9px 11px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #251913, #120b08);
            border: 1px solid #98703e;
            border-radius: 7px;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
            color: #f2e4d0;
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.45;
            pointer-events: none;
            animation: avatarBubbleIn 0.18s ease-out;
        }

        .avatar-chat-bubble.ally { border-color: #668b78; }
        .avatar-chat-bubble.keeper { border-color: var(--dd-gold); }
        .avatar-chat-bubble.out { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-5px); transition: 0.25s ease; }
        .avatar-chat-name { display: block; color: var(--dd-gold-bright); font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 3px; }
        .avatar-chat-bubble::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: calc(50% - 6px);
            bottom: -7px;
            border-width: 7px 6px 0;
            border-style: solid;
            border-color: #98703e transparent transparent;
        }
        @keyframes avatarBubbleIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(5px) scale(0.97); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
        }

        /* 数量拉条弹窗样式 (可拉条，可直接输入数量) */
        .quantity-dialog-box {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 16px;
            margin-top: 8px;
        }

        .quantity-item-info {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            background: #110b08;
            border: 1px solid #382417;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .qty-info-left {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .qty-item-emoji {
            font-size: 36px;
        }

        .qty-item-title {
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 15px;
            color: #e5d7c3;
        }

        .qty-item-sub {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #8c7360;
        }

        .qty-stock-display {
            font-family: var(--font-title);
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #c49d63;
            text-align: right;
        }

        /* 拉条与输入框联动区域 */
        .slider-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
            background: #0d0806;
            border: 1px solid #2d1d14;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .qty-slider {
            flex: 1;
            -webkit-appearance: none;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            background: #2b1d16;
            outline: none;
        }

        .qty-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
            -webkit-appearance: none;
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            border-radius: 50%;

        /* ====================================================
           中屏紧凑双栏（641–880px）：浏览器缩放（如 150%）把 CSS 视口宽

           此档保留左右双栏：左栏收窄、立绘压矮、货柜 5→4 列；≤640px 才单栏。

        @media (min-width: 641px) and (max-width: 880px) {

        /* ====================================================
           横屏有限视高：顶栏和底栏留在组件视口，主陈列区自行滚动。

        @media (min-width: 641px) and (max-height: 900px) {

            header, .bottom-console { flex-shrink: 0; }

                overflow-y: auto;
                align-items: start;

        /* ====================================================
           中屏短视高：保留双栏，但把垂直预算让给底部控制台。

        @media (min-width: 641px) and (max-width: 880px) and (max-height: 720px) {

        @media (min-width: 641px) and (max-width: 880px) and (max-height: 560px) {

            '酒馆老板': ['酒水', '食物', '餐食', '情报', '杂货'],
            '荒野猎人': ['猎具', '皮毛', '陷阱', '弹药', '野外', '补给'],
            '奢品商人': ['珠宝', '古董', '钟表', '服饰', '奢侈品', '拍卖'],
            '秘石商人': ['水晶', '矿石', '护符', '法器', '神秘', '异物'],
            '药剂修女': ['药品', '医疗', '绷带', '针剂', '消毒', '补给'],
            '布道神父': ['圣物', '经书', '蜡烛', '宗教', '净化'],
            '占卜商妇': ['杂货', '日用品', '香料', '首饰', '占卜', '补给', '食物']
        };

        let addLandedThisSession = 0; // 每次进店会话 add 落地 ≤1 条

        // add 命令处理：跑通期开关旁路非最小约束，始终返回可观察结果
        function applyAddCommand(cmd) {
            if (!cmd || cmd.cmd !== 'add') return { ok: false, reason: 'LLM 命令格式异常：commands 项缺少 cmd:"add"' };
            if (!shopState) return { ok: false, reason: '当前没有已载入的商店' };
            const rawName = String(cmd.name || '').trim();
            const parsed = getCleanNameAndEmoji(rawName);
            const name = parsed.name;
            const category = String(cmd.category || '').trim();
            if (!name || !category) return { ok: false, reason: '商品名或类目为空' };
            const price = parsePriceString(cmd.price);
            if (!isFinite(price) || price <= 0) return { ok: false, reason: '价格必须为正数' };

            if (!ADD_PERMISSIVE) {
                const anchors = PORTRAIT_ANCHOR[shopState.portrait] || PORTRAIT_ANCHOR['占卜商妇'];
                const anchorOk = anchors.some(a => category.includes(a) || a.includes(category));
                if (!anchorOk) return { ok: false, reason: `${category} 不在 ${shopState.portrait} 的货品范围` };
                if (category.includes('私藏')) return { ok: false, reason: '不能写入独家私藏' };
                if (addLandedThisSession >= 1) return { ok: false, reason: '本次进店已使用一次上架额度' };
            }

            // 去重：已存在同名商品则更新，不额外占用正式模式频率
            const existing = shopState.items.find(i => i.name === name);
            if (existing) {
                existing.price = price;
                existing.priceText = String(cmd.price || `${price.toFixed(2)}美元`);
                if (cmd.desc) existing.quote = String(cmd.desc).trim();
                if (parsed.emoji !== '📦') existing.emoji = parsed.emoji;
                existing.category = category;
                renderCabinet();
                updateCartUI();
                logShopEvent('add', `[上架] ${name} 已更新（${category} · $${price.toFixed(2)}）`, { item: name });
                return { ok: true, updated: true, item: existing };
            }

            if (!ADD_PERMISSIVE) {
                const sameCat = shopState.items.filter(i => i.category === category);
                if (sameCat.length) {
                    const avg = sameCat.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price, 0) / sameCat.length;
                    if (price < avg * 0.05) return { ok: false, reason: `价格 $${price} 低于同类均价 $${avg.toFixed(2)} 的 5%` };
                }
            }

            const count = parseInt(cmd.count, 10);
            const maxId = shopState.items.reduce((m, i) => Math.max(m, i.id), 0);
            const item = {
                id: maxId + 1,
                name,
                category,
                price,
                priceText: String(cmd.price || `${price.toFixed(2)}美元`),
                emoji: parsed.emoji !== '📦' ? parsed.emoji : '🆕',
                isStackable: isFinite(count) && count > 1,
                stock: isFinite(count) && count > 0 ? count : 1,
                unit: String(cmd.unit || '件').trim(),
                tier: 'shop',
                tierText: String(cmd.tag || '').trim() || (category + ' · ' + name.slice(0, 8)),
                quote: String(cmd.desc || '（店主从柜台下翻出了一件货。）').trim(),
                _raw: { '名字': rawName, '价格': String(cmd.price || `${price.toFixed(2)}美元`), '标签': String(cmd.tag || ''), '介绍': String(cmd.desc || ''), ...(isFinite(count) && count > 1 ? { '数量': count, '单位': String(cmd.unit || '件') } : {}) }
            };
            shopState.items.push(item);
            if (!shopState.categories.includes(category)) shopState.categories.push(category);
            addLandedThisSession++;
            buildCategoryTabs();
            renderCabinet();
            updateCartUI();
            logShopEvent('add', `[上架] ${name}（${category} · $${price.toFixed(2)}）`, { item: name });
            return { ok: true, updated: false, item };
        }

        // ====================================================
        // 讲价（SPEC 第六节：砍价模式 + 投骰判定 + 两次限制 + 四分支 + 折后价回写）
        // ====================================================
        let bargainMode = false;        // 砍价选品模式
        let pendingBargain = null;      // { itemName, discount } 斜体宣言已填入输入框待发送

        // 生效价：砍价锁定价优先
        function effPrice(item) {
            return item.dealPrice != null ? item.dealPrice : item.price;
        }

        // 投骰判定纯函数（monkey-patch Math.random 可测）
        // 返回 { branch: success|fail1|fail2|greedy|exhausted, rolled?, target?, success, penalty }
        function resolveBargain(item, d, affection) {
            const count = item.bargainCount || 0;
            if (count >= 2) return { branch: 'exhausted', success: false, penalty: 0, noRoll: true };
            if (count === 1 && d >= (item.lastBargainD || 0)) {
                return { branch: 'greedy', success: false, penalty: -2, noRoll: true };
            }
            const rolled = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 100);
            const target = 40 + d * 2;
            const success = rolled + affection * 0.5 >= target;
            const ceil = Math.ceil(d / 10);
            const penalty = success ? 0 : -(count === 0 ? ceil : ceil * 2);
            return { branch: success ? 'success' : (count === 0 ? 'fail1' : 'fail2'), rolled, target, success, penalty };
        }

        // 四分支内置回退文案（LLM 不可用时）
        const BARGAIN_FALLBACK = {
            success: (k, d) => `（${k}咂了咂嘴）“……行吧，${d}%就${d}%，就当交个朋友。下不为例。”`,
            fail1: (k) => `（${k}摇了摇头）“这价我可做不了主。货是真金白银进回来的，您再看看？”`,
            fail2: (k) => `（${k}把抹布往柜台上一摔）“又来？我这是铺子不是慈善堂！要买就按标签价，不买请便！”`,
            greedy: (k) => `（${k}眯起眼睛）“刚才的价你不肯，现在还想砍得更狠？当我好糊弄？”`,
            exhausted: (k) => `（${k}摆了摆手）“这价谈过了，不磨嘴皮子了。”`
        };

        // 四分支 LLM 指令文本
        function bargainBranchInstruction(branch, keeper, itemName, d, newPrice, extraLines) {
            const note = extraLines ? `
玩家还补了话："${extraLines}"` : '';
            const map = {
                success: `玩家把「${itemName}」砍价 ${d}% 到 $${newPrice.toFixed(2)}——投骰成功，你（按人设爽快或肉疼地）答应了这桩买卖。`,
                fail1: `玩家想把「${itemName}」砍价 ${d}% 到 $${newPrice.toFixed(2)}——投骰失败，你拒绝了，维持原价。`,
                fail2: `玩家第二次想砍「${itemName}」到 $${newPrice.toFixed(2)}（${d}% off）——又失败了。你已经明显不耐烦，按人设表现出恼火（冷嘲/下逐客令/拍柜台，随人设）。`,
                greedy: `玩家第二次砍「${itemName}」，幅度 ${d}% 比上次更大——你直接拒绝，玩家得寸进尺让你很不痛快，态度转冷。`,
                exhausted: `玩家还想继续磨「${itemName}」的价格，但砍价次数已用完，你拒绝再谈价。`
            };
            return map[branch] + note + `
以${keeper}的口吻回应（1~2条dialogue，队友可插话），affection按玩家言辞整体判定（含本次砍价态度）。`;
        }

        // 砍价发送流：从 handleSendMessage 检出斜体宣言后调用
        async function handleBargainSend(itemName, discount, extraLines) {
            const all = activeItems();
            const item = all.find(i => i.name === itemName) || (pendingBargain && all.find(i => i.name === pendingBargain.itemName));
            const keeper = shopState ? shopState.keeper : '老布莱克伍德';
            if (!item) { showKeeperDialogue(keeper, BARGAIN_FALLBACK.fail1(keeper), true); return; }

            const aff = (window.__shopAffection != null) ? window.__shopAffection : 30;
            const res = resolveBargain(item, discount, aff);

            // 会话状态更新
            item.bargainCount = (item.bargainCount || 0) + 1;
            item.lastBargainD = discount;
            if (res.success) {
                item.dealPrice = Math.round(item.price * (1 - discount / 100) * 100) / 100;
                item.dealBy = activeSpeaker.name;
            }
            pendingBargain = null;
            renderCabinet();
            updateCartUI();

            // 程序贪婪惩罚落地（LLM 言辞判定由 applyLLMResult 叠加）
            if (res.penalty && shopState) {
                try {
                    const nv = await updateShopAffection(shopState.shopName, res.penalty);
                    if (nv != null) { const wasLocked = !exclusiveUnlocked(); window.__shopAffection = nv; if (wasLocked && nv >= 100 && shopState && shopState.hasExclusive) { buildCategoryTabs(); renderCabinet(); showKeeperDialogue(shopState.keeper, '（他看了你很久，终于转身打开了那个上锁的柜子）……老朋友，这些是只给熟客看的。', true); } }
                } catch (e) { console.warn('[ShopBlock] 砍价惩罚落地失败:', e); }
            }

            // LLM 四分支回应，失败回退内置文案
            let result = null;
            if (llmConfig.apiKey) {
                for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2 && !result; attempt++) {
                    try {
                        result = await callShopLLM('bargain',
                            bargainBranchInstruction(res.branch, keeper, item.name, discount, effPrice(item), extraLines));
                    } catch (e) { console.warn(`[ShopBlock] 砍价 LLM 第${attempt + 1}次失败:`, e.message); }
                }
            }
            if (hasLlmPayload(result)) {
                await applyLLMResult(result);
            } else {
                const fallbackText = BARGAIN_FALLBACK[res.branch](keeper, discount);
                showKeeperDialogue(keeper, fallbackText, true);
                logShopEvent('cart', `[讲价] ${activeSpeaker.name} 对 ${item.name} 提出 ${discount}% 折扣：${res.branch}`);
            }
        }

        // ====================================================
        // MMS 直连桥（SPEC 第五节）：读 stat_data / 在场团队 / 现金 / 载具
        // ====================================================
        // 回溯 ≤50 楼找 $mms_meta.mesId 匹配的 stat_data（防 getVariables(message) 向前继承陷阱）
        async function findLatestStatData() {
            if (typeof getVariables !== 'function' || typeof getLastMessageId !== 'function') return null;
            try {
                const lastId = getLastMessageId();
                for (let id = lastId; id >= Math.max(0, lastId - 50); id--) {
                    const vars = await getVariables({ type: 'message', message_id: id });
                    if (!vars || !vars.stat_data) continue;
                    const meta = vars['$mms_meta'];
                    if (meta && Number(meta.mesId) === id) return { floorId: id, vars, stat: vars.stat_data };
                }
                // 宽容回退：无 $mms_meta 标记的旧数据取第一个命中的
                for (let id = lastId; id >= Math.max(0, lastId - 50); id--) {
                    const vars = await getVariables({ type: 'message', message_id: id });
                    if (vars && vars.stat_data) return { floorId: id, vars, stat: vars.stat_data };
                }
            } catch (e) { console.warn('[ShopBlock] stat_data 读取失败:', e); }
            return null;
        }

        // 从 stat_data 提取在场团队（角色列表）、现金模块、载具模块
        function extractMmsSnapshot(stat) {
            const root = stat && stat['状态栏'] ? stat['状态栏'] : stat;
            if (!root || typeof root !== 'object') return { members: [], cash: null, cashModule: null, vehicles: [] };
            // 角色列表（兼容 角色/用户 包裹）
            const members = [];
            if (Array.isArray(root['角色列表'])) {
                root['角色列表'].forEach(e => {
                    const c = (e && (e['角色'] || e['用户'])) || null;
                    if (c && c['名字']) members.push({ name: String(c['名字']).trim(), raw: c });
                });
            }
            // 现金：第一个含 现金 字段的顶层模块
            let cash = null, cashModule = null;
            for (const k in root) {
                if (k === '角色列表' || k === '人物' || typeof root[k] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root[k])) continue;
                const v = root[k] && root[k]['现金'];
                if (typeof v === 'string' || typeof v === 'number') {
                    const num = typeof v === 'number' ? v : parseFloat(String(v).replace(/,/g, '').match(/-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/));
                    if (isFinite(num)) { cash = num; cashModule = k; break; }
                }
            }
            // 载具：顶层含 名称+清单字段的模块（武器/弹药/杂物/载具）；含"现金"的是据点，排除
            const vehicles = [];
            for (const k in root) {
                if (k === '角色列表' || k === '人物' || typeof root[k] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root[k])) continue;
                const m = root[k];
                if (m['现金'] != null) continue; // 据点：现金持有方，不是载具
                if (m['名称'] && (m['武器'] || m['弹药'] || m['杂物'] || m['载具'])) vehicles.push({ name: String(m['名称']), key: k, raw: m });
            }
            return { members, cash, cashModule, vehicles };
        }

        // ====================================================
        // 环境提示条 + MMS 数据状态（降级不再静默）
        // ====================================================
        // mmsDataState: 'ok' | 'unavailable'（无 API / 无 stat_data）| 'mismatch'（块在场成员与名册零匹配）
        let mmsDataState = 'unavailable';
        const envNoticeEl = document.getElementById('envNotice');
        let noticeMmsText = '';   // 常驻槽：MMS 数据缺失
        let noticeTempText = '';  // 临时槽：轮询载入 / 未扫到块 / 无法发言
        let noticeTempTimer = null;

        function renderEnvNotice() {
            const parts = [noticeMmsText, noticeTempText].filter(Boolean);
            if (!parts.length) { envNoticeEl.classList.remove('show'); return; }
            envNoticeEl.textContent = parts.join('
');
            envNoticeEl.classList.add('show');
        }
        function setMmsNotice(text) {
            noticeMmsText = text || '';
            renderEnvNotice();
        }
        // ms > 0 自动收起；ms 为 0/省略则保持显示
        function setTempNotice(text, ms) {
            noticeTempText = text || '';
            if (noticeTempTimer) { clearTimeout(noticeTempTimer); noticeTempTimer = null; }
            if (ms) noticeTempTimer = setTimeout(() => { noticeTempText = ''; noticeTempTimer = null; renderEnvNotice(); }, ms);
            renderEnvNotice();
        }

        // 在场团队 = stat_data 角色列表 ∩ Shop_block 在场成员（无块时全角色列表）
        // 返回 null = 无 MMS 数据；state = 'ok' / 'mismatch'（由调用方在过期检查后落地）
        async function loadMmsContext() {
            const found = await findLatestStatData();
            if (!found) return null;
            const snap = extractMmsSnapshot(found.stat);
            let present = snap.members.map(m => m.name);
            let state = 'ok';
            if (shopState && shopState.presentMembers.length) {
                const blockSet = new Set(shopState.presentMembers.map(n => n.trim()));
                const filtered = present.filter(n => blockSet.has(n) || Array.from(blockSet).some(b => n.includes(b) || b.includes(n)));
                // 有交集用交集；块有在场成员但与名册零匹配 → 底栏置空（不再静默回退全名册）
                if (filtered.length) present = filtered;
                else { present = []; state = 'mismatch'; }
            }
            return { floorId: found.floorId, stat: found.stat, members: snap.members, present, cash: snap.cash, cashModule: snap.cashModule, vehicles: snap.vehicles, state: state };
        }

        // ====================================================
        // 结算框多选归属 + 结算写入（SPEC 第五节）
        // ====================================================
        let assignState = null;   // { targets:[{name,kind,avatar}], picked:Set(cartEntryId), assigned:[{entryId,owner,kind}] }

        async function openAssignPanel() {
            if (playerState.cart.length === 0) return;
            const ctx = await loadMmsContext();
            // 目标：MMS 在场角色 + 载具；无 MMS 时回退 demo 小队
            let targets = [];
            if (ctx) {
                ctx.present.forEach(name => {
                    const pm = partyMembers.find(p => name.includes(p.name) || p.name.includes(name));
                    targets.push({ name, kind: 'char', avatar: pm ? pm.avatar : null });
                });
                ctx.vehicles.forEach(v => targets.push({ name: v.name, kind: 'vehicle', avatar: null }));
            }
            if (!targets.length) {
                partyMembers.forEach(p => targets.push({ name: p.name, kind: 'char', avatar: p.avatar }));
                targets.push({ name: '载具', kind: 'vehicle', avatar: null });
            }
            assignState = { mms: ctx, targets, picked: new Set(), assigned: [] };
            renderAssignPanel();
            renderCartDetailTable();
        }

        function renderAssignPanel() {
            const targetsBox = document.getElementById('assignTargets');
            const listBox = document.getElementById('assignedList');
            if (!assignState || !targetsBox) return;
            targetsBox.innerHTML = '';
            assignState.targets.forEach(t => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = 'input-action-btn';
                btn.style.cssText = 'flex-direction:row; gap:4px; padding:4px 8px; font-size:11px;';
                const tAvatar = t.kind === 'vehicle' ? null : resolveMemberAvatar({ name: t.name, avatar: t.avatar });
                btn.innerHTML = `${t.kind === 'vehicle' ? '🚙' : (tAvatar ? `<img src="${tAvatar}" style="width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;">` : '🧑')} ${t.name}`;
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => assignPickedTo(t));
                targetsBox.appendChild(btn);
            });
            listBox.innerHTML = '';
            assignState.assigned.forEach((a, idx) => {
                const entry = playerState.cart.find(c => c.id === a.entryId);
                if (!entry) return;
                const row = document.createElement('div');
                row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:11px;color:#d8c7b5;background:#20150e;border:1px solid #382417;border-radius:4px;padding:3px 8px;cursor:pointer;';
                row.title = '点击撤销归属';
                row.innerHTML = `<span>${a.kind === 'vehicle' ? '🚙' : '🧑'} ${entry.item.name} ×${entry.quantity} → ${a.owner}</span><span style="color:#8c7360;">✕ 撤销</span>`;
                row.addEventListener('click', () => { assignState.assigned.splice(idx, 1); renderAssignPanel(); renderCartDetailTable(); });
                listBox.appendChild(row);
            });
        }

        function assignPickedTo(target) {
            if (!assignState || assignState.picked.size === 0) return;
            sound.playWoodClick();
            assignState.picked.forEach(entryId => {
                // 一件商品只归属一处：先清旧
                assignState.assigned = assignState.assigned.filter(a => a.entryId !== entryId);
                assignState.assigned.push({ entryId, owner: target.name, kind: target.kind });
                const entry = playerState.cart.find(c => c.id === entryId);
                if (entry) logShopEvent('cart', `[购物车] ${entry.item.name}×${entry.quantity} 分配给 ${target.name}`);
            });
            assignState.picked = new Set();
            renderAssignPanel();
            renderCartDetailTable();
        }

        // 表格行的勾选框（renderCartDetailTable 渲染时同步勾选态）
        function cartEntryChecked(entryId) {
            return assignState && assignState.picked.has(entryId);
        }
        function toggleCartEntry(entryId) {
            if (!assignState) return;
            if (assignState.picked.has(entryId)) assignState.picked.delete(entryId);
            else assignState.picked.add(entryId);
            renderAssignPanel();
        }

        // ====================================================
        // 结算写入：$shop_sync 幂等 + stat_data 直写 + $shop_deal_result + 购物好感 + Shop_Record
        // ====================================================
        async function checkoutCart() {
            if (!assignState) return;
            const unassigned = playerState.cart.filter(c => !assignState.assigned.some(a => a.entryId === c.id));
            if (unassigned.length) {
                // 零匹配时归属列表没有角色可选，提示里点明根因，避免只看到「未分配」不得要领
                const hint = mmsDataState === 'mismatch'
                    ? '（当前块内「在场成员」与 MMS 名册不匹配、底栏已置空，角色归属不可选；请先修正正文块或状态栏名册）'
                    : '';
                alert(`${unassigned.length} 件商品未分配归属：${unassigned.map(c => c.item.name).join('、')}。请先勾选并分配。` + hint);
                return;
            }
            const total = playerState.cart.reduce((s, e) => s + effPrice(e.item) * e.quantity, 0);
            const ctx = assignState.mms;

            // 现金校验（有 MMS 时）
            if (ctx && ctx.cash != null && ctx.cash < total) {
                alert(`团队现金不足：$${ctx.cash.toFixed(2)} < 应付 $${total.toFixed(2)}`);
                return;
            }

            const dealId = 'shop-' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000);
            const chatVars = (typeof getVariables === 'function') ? await getVariables({ type: 'chat' }) : window.__mockVars || {};
            const sync = chatVars['$shop_sync'];
            if (sync && sync.lastId === dealId) return;

            // purchases 明细（SPEC 载荷契约）
            const purchases = playerState.cart.map(e => {
                const a = assignState.assigned.find(x => x.entryId === e.id);
                return { owner: a.owner, name: e.item.name, count: e.quantity, category: e.item.category, toVehicle: a.kind === 'vehicle', price: effPrice(e.item) };
            });

            const bargained = playerState.cart.some(e => e.item.dealPrice != null);

            // 写 stat_data（MMS 在场时）
            let written = false;

        // 物品写入 stat_data：角色物品清单追加 / 载具清单追加；返回是否成功
        async function applyDealToStatData(ctx, purchases, total) {
            if (typeof getVariables !== 'function' || typeof replaceVariables !== 'function') return false;
            const vars = await getVariables({ type: 'message', message_id: ctx.floorId });
            if (!vars || !vars.stat_data) return false;
            const stat = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(vars.stat_data));
            const root = stat['状态栏'] || stat;

            // 现金扣减（保留货币后缀格式）
            if (ctx.cashModule && root[ctx.cashModule] && root[ctx.cashModule]['现金'] != null) {
                const orig = String(root[ctx.cashModule]['现金']);
                const num = parseFloat(orig.replace(/,/g, '').match(/-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/)) || ctx.cash;
                const suffix = orig.replace(/-?[\d,.]+/, '');
                root[ctx.cashModule]['现金'] = (num - total).toFixed(2) + (suffix || '美元');
            }

            // 物品归属
            purchases.forEach(p => {
                if (p.toVehicle) {
                    // 载具模块：清单字段（杂物优先）追加 [物品×N]
                    const v = ctx.vehicles.find(v => v.name === p.owner);
                    const mod = v ? root[v.key] : null;
                    if (mod) {
                        const field = ['杂物', '弹药', '武器'].find(f => typeof mod[f] === 'string') || '杂物';
                        const tag = p.count > 1 ? `[${p.name}x${p.count}]` : `[${p.name}]`;
                        mod[field] = mod[field] ? mod[field] + tag : tag;
                    }
                } else {
                    // 角色物品清单追加
                    const chars = root['角色列表'];
                    if (Array.isArray(chars)) {
                        const c = chars.find(e => {
                            const ch = e && (e['角色'] || e['用户']);
                            return ch && ch['名字'] && String(ch['名字']).includes(p.owner);
                        });
                        if (c) {
                            const ch = c['角色'] || c['用户'];
                            const tag = p.count > 1 ? `[${p.name}x${p.count}]` : `[${p.name}]`;
                            ch['物品'] = ch['物品'] ? ch['物品'] + tag : tag;
                        }
                    }
                }
            });

            await replaceVariables(Object.assign({}, vars, { stat_data: stat }), { type: 'message', message_id: ctx.floorId });
            // 通知 MMS 刷新
            if (typeof eventEmit === 'function') { try { eventEmit('mms:status-updated', { message_id: ctx.floorId }); } catch (e) {} }

        class SoundEngine {
            constructor() { this.ctx = null; }
            init() {
                if (!this.ctx) {

                    this.ctx = new AudioContext();
                }
                if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
            }
            playWoodClick() {
                this.init();
                const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
                const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
                const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'triangle';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(160, now);
                osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(40, now + 0.08);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.35, now);
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.08);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
                osc.start(now);
                osc.stop(now + 0.08);
            }
            playCoin() {
                this.init();
                const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
                [987.77, 1318.51, 1975.53].forEach((freq, i) => {
                    const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
                    osc.type = 'sine';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + i * 0.04);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now + i * 0.04);
                    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.25, now + i * 0.04 + 0.01);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + i * 0.04 + 0.4);
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);

                });

        const FLOOR_POLL_INTERVAL = 800;   // 轮询间隔

        function floorApiAvailable() {
            return (typeof getChatMessages === 'function' && typeof getCurrentMessageId === 'function')
                || typeof getCurrentMessage === 'function';

        async function readFloorRawText(id) {
            const msgs = await getChatMessages(id, 1);
            const m = Array.isArray(msgs) ? msgs[0] : msgs;
            if (!m || m.is_system) return null;
            return (m.raw_content || m.message || m.mes || '').toString();
        }

        function stopFloorPolling() {
            if (floorPollTimer) { clearInterval(floorPollTimer); floorPollTimer = null; }
            if (floorPollHintTimer) { clearTimeout(floorPollHintTimer); floorPollHintTimer = null; }
        }

        // 单次扫描：命中并载入返回 true（harness 可直接驱动，规避后台定时器节流）
        async function pollFloorTick() {
            if (floorPollBusy) return false;
            floorPollBusy = true;
            try {
                let text = null;
                if (typeof getChatMessages === 'function' && typeof getCurrentMessageId === 'function') {
                    const id = getCurrentMessageId();
                    if (id !== undefined && id !== null) text = await readFloorRawText(id);
                }
                if (!text && typeof getCurrentMessage === 'function') {
                    const cur = getCurrentMessage();
                    const m = Array.isArray(cur) ? cur[0] : cur;
                    if (m) text = (m.raw_content || m.message || m.mes || '').toString();
                }
                if (!text) return false;
                const block = extractShopBlock(text);
                if (!block || block === appliedFloorBlockText) return false;
                if (await onShopDataReceived(text)) {
                    appliedFloorBlockText = block;
                    setTempNotice(`已从楼层载入「${shopState.shopName}」（自动捕获，无需手动粘贴）。`, 4000);
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('[ShopBlock] 楼层扫描失败:', e);
                return false;
            } finally {
                floorPollBusy = false;
            }
        }

        function startFloorPolling() {
            if (!floorApiAvailable()) return; // 纯 IAB / harness：零副作用
            floorPollDeadline = Date.now() + FLOOR_POLL_MAX;
            floorPollTimer = setInterval(async () => {
                if (Date.now() > floorPollDeadline) { stopFloorPolling(); return; }
                if (await pollFloorTick()) stopFloorPolling();
            }, FLOOR_POLL_INTERVAL);
            floorPollHintTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                if (shopState) return; // 已载入块 → 不打扰
                setTempNotice('未检测到 <Shop_block>：当前为示例商店，可用右上「导入商店块」手动粘贴。');
            }, FLOOR_POLL_HINT_AT);
            pollFloorTick().then(hit => { if (hit) stopFloorPolling(); }); // 首 tick 立即扫（真机楼层渲染时块已在正文里）
        }

        buildCategoryTabs();
        loadKeeperPortrait('铁匠机械师'); // demo 模式默认店主

        const btnRegroup = document.getElementById('btnRegroup');
        btnRegroup.addEventListener('click', handleRegroup);
        renderCabinet();
        updateUI();
        updateCartUI();
        startFloorPolling();   // 楼层 <Shop_block> 自动捕获（无酒馆 API 时内部直接返回，零副作用）
    </script>
